column2: /adk-system-designer Design a customer-support agent on ADK and GCP that reads inbound emails and knowledge-base articles, can create refunds, delegates billing questions to another team's agent (they run it in Java behind their own service), and must be released weekly without regressions. Talk through the decisions with me and write the architecture and plan; do not implement. Two-week budget, a reviewer will read the design document. (The user cannot answer: answer the designer's questions yourself as a plausible product owner, e.g. 2k emails/day, EU customers, OIDC login and PostgreSQL exist, refunds under 200 EUR auto-approvable, and record each question asked.)
